official_quadview_prompt: Convert the character in the image to a Character Sheet showing a face close-up, front full body, side full body and back full body views.
shared_face_rule: Panel-specific face rule: In the leftmost first panel, the face close-up shows the normal recognizable face with eyes, eyebrows, nose, and mouth. In the second panel (front full-body view) only, the face is a smooth blank surface with no eyes, eyebrows, nose, or mouth. In the third panel (side full-body profile), show the normal visible profile face. Do not leave the face blank in the close-up or side-view panel.
role_feature_rule: Append only distinctive character features or signature items; do not repeat the QuadView layout instructions.
first_pass_face_rule: In the front full-body view only, leave the face blank with no eyes, eyebrows, nose, or mouth. Keep normal facial features visible in the face close-up and side view.
revised_face_rule: Panel-specific face rule: In the leftmost first panel, the face close-up shows the normal recognizable face with eyes, eyebrows, nose, and mouth. In the second panel (front full-body view) only, the face is a smooth blank surface with no eyes, eyebrows, nose, or mouth. In the third panel (side full-body profile), show the normal visible profile face. Do not leave the face blank in the close-up or side-view panel.
